crossRefs.note: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

It will happen in that day that Yahweh will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Tell Aaron, ‘Stretch out your rod, and strike the dust of the earth, that it may become lice…

translations.web: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.
translations.bsb: He spoke, and insects swarmed— gnats throughout their country.
translations.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.
translations.asv: He spake, and there came swarms of flies, And lice in all their borders.
